Full colors preview/publication cache identities include device, inode and ctime; native extraction uses a read-only cache_dir for its frozen palette result.

Real nested compositor sessions, native lock/login rendering across font stacks, hardware writes/signals, privileged deployment, online weather/lyrics and remote sync remain integration checks.
Optional embedding model installation/inference needs its pinned local model and platform; absence/disabled behavior and provision argv are frozen.

absolute_xdg_roots.reason: Rust Paths follows NacrePaths.qml: absolute XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_STATE_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME override HOME defaults; unset, empty and relative values retain defaults. Legacy Python helpers that ignored custom XDG roots intentionally differ.

absolute_xdg_roots.coverage: Current frozen cases use default XDG roots; no existing reference changed or excluded. Custom-XDG cases must explicitly declare this intended difference and verify the redirected files/output.

argument_error_wording.reason: Native CLI parsers retain help stdout, accepted arguments, parse-error exit 2 and no side effects; diagnostic stderr wording differs from argparse.

bounded_capture_tools.reason: Native screen-reading grim and clipboard operations have a five-second failure deadline; legacy subprocess calls could wait indefinitely. Successful results/files/argv/clipboard bytes remain exact.
